quests.instruction: IDENTIFY THE TARGET CONSONANT PHONEME IN THE WORD
quests.hint: At this level, listen for subtle articulation: is it closer to a voiced dental fricative or a voiced alveolar fricative in "worthy"?
quests.explanation: In "worthy", the target sound is /ð/, made by resting the tongue tip lightly between the teeth with the voice on. The distractor /z/ would instead require buzzing a thin stream of air over the tongue tip with the voice on — a clearly different sound once you isolate it.
quests.mouthPosition: Notice where your tongue and lips are placed to shape this consonant perfectly.
